Zelensky on Crimea Bridge strike:

Putin attacked Ukrainian bridges 109 times — not once, not twice, but 109 times. 

That is why our response was justified.

Zelensky:

For now it is too early to say whether we will be in NATO or will not be, because all of this depends on when and how this war ends.

Undoubtedly, Ukraine very much wants NATO. And unquestionably, this is definitely a cheaper model. 

Because a standalone Ukrainian army without NATO would need to maintain an army of a million, its own air force, artillery, missiles, and air defense capabilities. 

All of that will exist if Ukraine becomes a member of NATO, but it will certainly be cheaper for everyone.
